arguments.prompt:
Create a corrected NEW native pixel-art animation atlas of Aayla Secura, using the attached sheet as design reference only. Appearance: the ADULT blue Twi'lek Jedi from Star Wars Revenge of the Sith (2005), two long blue lekku, brown headwrap and brown practical Jedi field costume, ONE BLUE lightsaber in her hand. No extra blade or invented power. The earlier sheet has excessive blade smears that merge neighbouring figures. Correct that problem completely: compact clean straight physical lightsaber blades with at most a tiny subtle rim glow; NO arc trails, big luminous smears, energy ribbons, cloud, aura, projectile or detached effect. The blade must always remain inside the same generous isolated cell as its own body. In quiet sequences the weapons are safely held low close to the body, or inactive hilts are retained; no swinging across neighbours.

STRICT: exactly 48 complete separated figures, EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, same anatomical scale, all facing screen-right in coherent 3/4 side view. Genuinely transparent spacious canvas, no labels, text, drawn grid, floor, shadow, panels or other people. Every row contains TWO different four-frame sequences. All full bodies, lekku, hands and complete blades have large empty margins. Absolutely no overlap or touching between figures, no clipped blade/body, no duplicate complete pose.

ROW1 first4 INTRO calm ready stance, last4 OUTRO lower equipment and leave. ROW2 first4 ROUND VICTORY quiet nod, last4 ROUND DEFEAT catch breath and regain posture. ROW3 first4 FINISHING PRESENTATION one compact controlled close physical lightsaber cut then recover, last4 MATCH VICTORY restrained individual acknowledgement, clearly different from round victory. ROW4 first4 MATCH DEFEAT slowly crouch to one knee and settle with weapons held low, last4 SUPER one separate newly drawn compact close lightsaber cut four-frame sequence. ROW5 first4 IDLE breathing and weight shift with blades safely close to the body, last4 RUN natural four-frame cycle with hilts retained safely. ROW6 first4 ORDINARY ATTACK compact four-frame lightsaber cut with complete blades and distinct poses, last4 HIT REACTION non-graphic recoil, guard, recover and settle. Each four-frame sequence has FOUR genuinely DIFFERENT native drawings. No firing or offensive effect in intro/outro/victory/defeat/idle/run/hit sequences.

No injury, opponent, blood, corpse or graphic spectacle. Respect selected identity and 48-figure 8x6 layout with generous transparent gaps; restoring clean separation is the central correction.
